title: Rigorous data curation, enrichment and meta-analysis enable autoML prediction of plant length responses to nanoparticles powered by the Enalos Cloud platform
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,621-640
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00897B, Paper
Open Access

Dimitra-Danai Varsou, Aikaterini Theodori, Anastasios G. Papadiamantis, Andreas Tsoumanis, Dimitrios Zouraris, Maria Antoniou, Nikoletta-Maria Koutroumpa, Georgia Melagraki, Iseult Lynch, Antreas Afantitis
A nanoparticle–plant dataset with atomistic descriptors was developed and used to train an optimized XGBoost model to predict nanoparticle effects on plant length without experimental data. Image designed with https://canva.com.
